$comment: LCARdS 2026.11.0-dev.1: generated from src/cards/schemas/ by scripts/generate-llm-schema.js; do not hand-edit.

camera.description: The camera: the view shown first, named views to fly between, drag and zoom controls and their limits.

view.description: The named view shown first. Default: the first of views; with no views the camera frames the whole scene. Or a guided tour: { entity, views } flies to views[n] when the entity's value is n (from 0), or to the view its text state names.

anyOf.description: A guided tour: the camera follows an entity (an input_number stage, an input_select of view names).

entity.description: The entity whose value picks the view.

attribute.description: Read this attribute instead of the state.

views.description: The stops in order: a number n flies to the nth (from 0, rounded, clamped). A stop is a view name, or { view, date, rate } to set the scene clock there too. Leave out when the state names the view.

view.description: The named view to fly to.

date.description: Set the scene date there: now or an ISO date.

rate.description: Set the date's rate there: live, days per second, or with a unit as the time slider shows it (1 h/s, 30 d/s, 1 y/s).

views.description: Named views (keys are your names). Fly between them with a tap_action (action: fly-to, view: <name>).

additionalProperties.description: A named camera view. The camera orbits a target: yaw turns round it, tilt raises it, distance moves away.

target.description: What the camera looks at: a point id or [x, y, z]. Default: where the camera looked before.

oneOf.description: A point id
Scene coordinates [x, y, z], scene units

yaw.description: The way the camera faces, degrees: 0 faces north (the default camera), 90 faces east. Default 0 when the card opens on the view; flown to, a view without yaw keeps the current one.

tilt.description: Camera height angle, degrees: 0 level with the target, 90 straight down. Default 35.

distance.description: Distance from the target, scene units.

fov.description: Vertical field of view, degrees (perspective only). Default 40. On a card wider than 2:1 it narrows so the view is never wider than on a 2:1 card (no wide-angle stretching at the sides).

projection.description: perspective: far things look smaller. orthographic: no perspective (a flat map); distance then sets the zoom.

warp.description: Stars and dust streak while the camera flies here (warp). Default camera.warp.

controls.description: Drag to orbit, mouse wheel or pinch to zoom, shift-drag, right-drag, middle-drag, a touchpad two-finger swipe or two fingers on a touch screen to pan, double-tap blank space to zoom in, arrow keys when focused. false: the camera only moves by fly-to and auto_rotate.

drag.description: What a one-finger or left-button drag does. orbit: turn round the target (shift or right button pans). pan: move the view (shift or right button orbits). A locked tilt always pans.

pan.description: What panning moves along. screen: the screen's left, right, up and down, so a side view pans up and down. ground: across the ground plane only, the target keeps its height.

zoom_to.description: Where the wheel and pinch zoom toward. cursor: the spot under the pointer stays put. target: straight in and out from the centre.

wheel.description: What wheel events do. auto: a mouse wheel zooms and a touchpad two-finger swipe pans (shift: orbits), told apart by the events. zoom: every wheel event zooms. pan: every wheel event pans. A pinch always zooms.

follow.description: After a fly-to lands on a point (a tap, a fly-to action, a view that targets it), the camera keeps the point at its centre while it moves; orbit and zoom still work round it. A pan, a double-tap zoom, a tap on blank space or another fly-to lets go. false: the camera stays where it landed.

zoom_step.description: Distance factor of one zoom step (double-tap, zoom buttons, plus and minus keys). Default 2: each step halves the distance.

double_tap.description: A double-tap or double-click. In blank space, zoom flies in one zoom step toward that spot, which becomes the centre (shift: zoom out); on a point, it flies in close to the largest object standing there (a few times its size). none: nothing. Taps on tappable objects are never affected.

buttons.description: On-card camera buttons: an LCARdS D-pad in the theme's D-pad colours (the arms pan, the centre resets to the start view, the corners zoom in and out (left) and fly forward and back (right)), with the time slider under it. Press and hold keeps moving. true for all of them in the bottom right; an object to choose. Default off.

position.description: Where the buttons sit on the card.

size.description: How big the D-pad is, px across. Default 180.

pan.description: The arms pan. false: they are dimmed and do nothing.

zoom.description: The left corners zoom in (top) and out (bottom). false: they are dimmed and do nothing.

travel.description: The right corners fly forward (top) and back (bottom): camera and target move together along the view, as the W and S keys. false: they are dimmed and do nothing.

reset.description: The centre resets (flies back to the start view). false: it is dimmed and does nothing.

scale.description: The model size button beside the pad: real size or visible size (model_scale), as the V key. Shown only when a model is drawn at its real size. false hides it.

time.description: The time slider. speed: how fast the scene's motion runs (time_scale: spins, scans, drift), from held to four times as fast. date: the scene clock (clock), with the date, its rate from a year a second backward to a year a second forward, and NOW. both: either, with a switch. true (the default): both when the card has a clock, else speed. false hides it. It changes the view only, not the config.

hide.description: When the buttons hide. idle: they fade out after a few seconds without input on the card and come back on any pointer movement, touch or key. never: always shown. toggle: a small button folds them away and back.

limits.description: Where drag and zoom stop: [min, max] pairs. A tilt range of one value (e.g. [90, 90]) locks the tilt, and a one-finger drag then pans (a map).

tilt.description: Lowest and highest tilt, degrees. Default [-90, 90].

distance.description: Nearest and farthest distance, scene units. Default: 1 to 100,000, widened for a scene at true scale (down to half its smallest object, out to 20 times its size).

yaw.description: Yaw range, degrees. Default: no limit.

target.description: Where the point the camera looks at may go, so panning cannot lose the scene. A sphere ({ radius, center }) or a box ({ x, y, z } ranges, an axis left out is free); false for no limit. Default: a sphere 1.5 times the size of the scene round its centre.

center.description: Sphere centre [x, y, z], scene units. Default: the centre of the scene.

x.description: Box: lowest and highest x, scene units.

y.description: Box: lowest and highest y, scene units.

z.description: Box: lowest and highest z, scene units.

auto_rotate.description: Turn the camera round its target, degrees per second (negative: the other way). 0 is off. Pauses while dragging; off under reduced motion.

fly_duration.description: How long a fly-to takes, ms. Under reduced motion the camera jumps.

ease.description: Easing of a fly-to (an anime.js easing name, such as inOutCubic, outQuad, linear).

warp.description: Every fly-to streaks the stars and dust (warp); a view's own warp wins. Or { entity } (and attribute): fly-tos streak while it is on (on, true, or a number above 0), such as an input_boolean. Off under reduced motion.

oneOf.description: Warp fly-tos from an entity

entity.description: The entity that makes fly-tos streak while it is on.

attribute.description: Read this attribute instead of the state.

backdrop.description: What is behind the scene objects.

stars.description: Stars at infinity: they turn with the camera and never move when it pans. true for the defaults, or settings.

brightness.description: Each star's brightness is picked at random between these [faintest, brightest], 0 to 1 (the seed picks the same ones every time). Default [0.35, 1].

colors.description: Several star colours, picked at random per star (wins over color).

opacity.description: Fades the whole star layer, 0 to 1: every star's brightness is multiplied by it.

seed.description: Random seed: the same seed places the same stars.

streak.description: How long stars and dust streak during a warp fly-to (camera.warp or a view's warp), a multiple of the usual length; 0: never.

spectrum.description: Streaks split into colour: a Doppler shift of each star's own colour, violet toward the tail and red toward the head (white stars show the whole rainbow). true, or { direction }. Default off.

direction.description: doppler: violet toward the tail, as a real Doppler shift. reverse: violet toward the head.

dust.description: Depth dust: faint particles that fill the space round the camera wherever it goes. They stay put as it moves, so every move shows depth, and streak in a warp fly-to. true for the defaults, or settings.

count.description: How many particles (about half of them are within reach of the camera at any time).

radius.description: How far round the camera the dust reaches (it fades out there), scene units. Smaller is denser and shows depth on smaller moves. Default 1.5 x the scene's radius.

brightness.description: Each particle's brightness is picked at random between these [faintest, brightest], 0 to 1. Default [0.35, 1].

colors.description: Several colours, picked at random per particle (wins over color).

opacity.description: Fades the whole dust layer, 0 to 1: every particle's brightness is multiplied by it.

spectrum.description: Streaks split into colour (a Doppler shift, as on the stars). true, or { direction }. Default off.

direction.description: doppler: violet toward the tail. reverse: violet toward the head.

labels.description: How labels are drawn: text defaults for every label, your own label styles, pixel snapping.

font_weight.description: Font weight: CSS keyword (normal, bold) or numeric value (100–900)

font_family.description: CSS font-family (single font, comma-separated stack, or CSS variable)

letter_spacing.description: Space between letters: px (a number) or a CSS letter-spacing such as 0.1em or 2px. Default normal.

background_padding.description: Space between the text and the sides of its background box, px.

background_radius.description: Corner radius of the background rect (px).

background_width.description: Fixed explicit width of the background rect (px). Overrides auto-sizing from text metrics. Text will overflow if content is wider than this value.

background_min_width.description: Minimum width of the background rect (px). Auto-sizes to text width but never smaller than this value. Safe for dynamic content.

default.description: Text keys every label on this card inherits (font_family, text_transform, letter_spacing, ...), over the built-in styles.

styles.description: Label styles by name: change a built-in (title, major, minor, tiny) or add your own; a point picks one with style.

additionalProperties.description: A label style: text keys (font_size, color, font_weight, ...) and priority.

font_weight.description: Font weight: CSS keyword (normal, bold) or numeric value (100–900)

font_family.description: CSS font-family (single font, comma-separated stack, or CSS variable)

letter_spacing.description: Space between letters: px (a number) or a CSS letter-spacing such as 0.1em or 2px. Default normal.

background_padding.description: Space between the text and the sides of its background box, px.

background_radius.description: Corner radius of the background rect (px).

background_width.description: Fixed explicit width of the background rect (px). Overrides auto-sizing from text metrics. Text will overflow if content is wider than this value.

background_min_width.description: Minimum width of the background rect (px). Auto-sizes to text width but never smaller than this value. Safe for dynamic content.

priority.description: Which label wins when two overlap (higher wins).

overlap.description: Labels of this style are never hidden by another label (they still move to a free side when they can).

Every label on the card: never hidden when labels overlap (each still moves to a free side of its point when it can). false hides the lower-priority one, which keeps busy scenes readable. A style or a point can set its own.

snap.description: Round label positions to whole px (crisper text on weak devices; fast motion looks steppier). Default: sub-pixel.

units.description: What one scene unit is (m, km, au, ly or pc): positions, sizes and distances are in it. Optional: a scene can use any units of its own (scene units); naming them lets a system (type: system) give its own, models and starter parts start at their real size, and bodies (body: points) sit at real distances. Naming them does not rescale what is already there.

model_scale.description: How models drawn at their real size (no size of their own) start: real (the default) keeps them in proportion, however small that is on screen; visible draws each at least 40 px across, real again once it is larger. The size button by the camera buttons, the V key and set-model-scale actions switch it on screen; that is not saved.

look.description: Draw the scene as an LCARS diagram, realistically, or both: diagram shows the objects and points with look: diagram, realistic those with look: realistic, mixed (the default) both; ones without a look always show. A change crossfades. Or { entity } (and attribute) whose state names the look, such as an input_select with the options diagram, realistic and mixed (any case).

oneOf.description: The look from an entity

entity.description: The entity whose state (or attribute) names the look.

attribute.description: Read this attribute instead of the state.

warp.description: Go to warp: the backdrop stars and dust streak along the view and the warp starfield (spectrum streaks) streams past behind the scene, at warp_factor; false drops out of warp. Or { entity } (and attribute): at warp while it is on (on, true, or a number above 0), such as an input_boolean. Nothing under reduced motion. (camera.warp is different: streaks during a fly-to.)

oneOf.description: Warp from an entity

entity.description: The entity that engages warp while it is on.

attribute.description: Read this attribute instead of the state.

warp_factor.description: How fast the stars stream at warp, 1 to 9.9 (default 6). Can follow an entity ({ entity, output }), such as a slider, or a template.

anyOf.description: A template that gives the number: [[[ return ... ]]], {{ ... }} or {entity.state}.

time_scale.description: Speed of the scene's motion (orbits, spins, drift, scans, trails): 1 as configured, 0.5 half speed, 2 twice as fast, 0 holds it still. Faster than 4 can be typed. The sky, the scene clock (clock) and the camera are not affected. The time slider (camera.buttons.time) changes it on screen. Can follow an entity ({ entity, output }) or a template.

anyOf.description: A template that gives the number: [[[ return ... ]]], {{ ... }} or {entity.state}.

clock.description: The scene's date: it starts at date and runs on at rate. Body points, body spheres and rings, orbit rings and the sky follow it. The time slider (camera.buttons.time: date), set-clock actions and lcards.set_clock change it on screen.

date.description: The date the scene starts at: now (the default) or a date and time. In YAML an ISO date or date and time (2026-10-30, 2026-10-30T12:00:00Z; a date alone is midnight UTC). Or { entity } to follow a date and time helper (an input_datetime), or a template.

rate.description: How fast the date runs: live (real time, the default), paused (0), or an amount of time per second. In YAML days per second (1 is a day a second, 30 a month, 365.25 a year; 0 holds it; negative runs back), or with a unit as the time slider shows it: 1 h/s (an hour a second), 30 d/s, 1 y/s, -1 d/s (units s, min, h, d, w, mo, y). Or { entity, output } to follow an entity, or a template.

anyOf.description: A template that gives the number: [[[ return ... ]]], {{ ... }} or {entity.state}.

points.description: Named points with optional labels and markers (the placement system).

items.description: A named point: placed once (one of xyz, polar, latlon, altaz, sky, at, cell, or part on a model), referenced by id from paths, rings, beams, objects and views. With a label or marker it shows on the scene.

id.description: Unique name of the point (referenced by at, target, from, to, around, points).

xyz.description: Position [x, y, z], scene units (y is up). With object: local to that object. Or { entity, attributes: [x, y, z] } to read it from an entity.

oneOf.description: The numbers.
Read the numbers from an entity's attributes (state for its state). The point moves when they change and is hidden while one is missing.

entity.description: The entity to read. Default: the point's entity.

attributes.description: The attributes holding x, y and z. Default [x, y, z].

polar.description: Position on the scene plane as [distance, bearing]: distance in scene units, bearing in degrees, 0 north, clockwise seen from above; alt lifts it. With object: local to that object. Or { entity, attributes: [distance, bearing] }.

oneOf.description: The numbers.
Read the numbers from an entity's attributes (state for its state). The point moves when they change and is hidden while one is missing.

entity.description: The entity to read. Default: the point's entity.

attributes.description: The attributes holding the distance and bearing. Default [distance, bearing].

latlon.description: Latitude and longitude [lat, lon] in degrees on the sphere named in object. Longitude 0 faces the default camera, east to the right; the point turns with the sphere's spin. Or { entity } for a person, device tracker or zone (its latitude and longitude attributes).

oneOf.description: The numbers.
Read the numbers from an entity's attributes (state for its state). The point moves when they change and is hidden while one is missing.

entity.description: The entity to read. Default: the point's entity.

latitude.description: The attribute holding the latitude. Default latitude.

longitude.description: The attribute holding the longitude. Default longitude.

altaz.description: Azimuth and altitude [azimuth, altitude] in degrees on the dome named in object: azimuth clockwise from north, altitude up from the horizon. Or { entity } (sun.sun: its azimuth and elevation attributes).

oneOf.description: The numbers.
Read the numbers from an entity's attributes (state for its state). The point moves when they change and is hidden while one is missing.

entity.description: The entity to read. Default: the point's entity.

azimuth.description: The attribute holding the azimuth. Default azimuth.

altitude.description: The attribute holding the altitude. Default elevation.

sky.description: Follow the sun or moon on the dome named in object, from the time and the Home Assistant location (sun.sun when it exists). Updated every minute. With a clock, the scene date instead of now.

body.description: Where a real Sun, planet, dwarf planet or moon is at the scene clock's date (clock; JPL elements), on its tilted, elliptical orbit. The Sun sits at the origin of the point's frame (the scene, or its system), in that frame's units: name them (units: km or au) or au is assumed. A moon is placed from the Sun too (its planet plus its own orbit).

center.description: body only: measure from this body instead of the Sun, so it sits at the origin (a Jupiter-centred scene of its moons).

at.description: Place it at another point (by id); add offset to move it from there.

cell.description: The centre of a sector map cell, such as AF3, on the grid named in object (a plane grid; its axis_labels say how cells are named).

object.description: The object the point stands on (an object id). Needed by latlon (a sphere), altaz and sky (a dome grid), cell (a plane grid) and part (a model); with xyz or polar the point moves and spins with the object (on a model: in the file's coordinates).

part.description: A named part (node) of the model in object: the point sits on it and follows it; xyz is an offset in the part's coordinates.

alt.description: Height above the surface of the object in object (latlon, altaz, sky), or above the plane (polar), scene units.

anyOf.description: A template that gives the number: [[[ return ... ]]], {{ ... }} or {entity.state}.

offset.description: Moves the point by [x, y, z] scene units from where its form puts it.

entity.description: The point's entity: its templates read it as entity, state colour maps follow its state, more-info and toggle actions use it, and latlon / altaz / xyz / polar can take their values from it.

tags.description: Tags for rules: a rule on tag:<name> patches every point with the tag.

hide_in_systems.description: Hide the label and marker while the camera is inside a star system (a system object), so galaxy-scale names step aside in the close-ups. Or a list of system ids: hidden inside those systems only (a route that belongs in the systems at its ends, not in the one it passes).

oneOf.description: The systems (their ids) to hide it in

look.description: Which look of the card shows the label and marker: diagram in the diagram and mixed looks, realistic in the realistic and mixed looks. Left out, it shows in every look.

label.description: Text shown at the point: short for text.label.content. Leave out for a marker only, or for a point that only anchors other things.

text.description: The label's text fields, as on other LCARdS cards: default holds keys every field inherits; every other key is a field (label is the main one; label: on the point is short for text.label.content).

default.description: Keys every text field of this point inherits (not drawn itself).

content.description: Text of this field. Templates are evaluated (the point's entity is entity; sky and point are available too); template: false shows it as written.

show.description: Whether to show this text field

font_weight.description: Font weight: CSS keyword (normal, bold) or numeric value (100–900)

font_family.description: CSS font-family (single font, comma-separated stack, or CSS variable)

letter_spacing.description: Space between letters: px (a number) or a CSS letter-spacing such as 0.1em or 2px. Default normal.

template.description: Template evaluation is enabled by default for this field’s content (e.g. {entity.state}, {{ states(...) }}, [[[ ... ]]]). Set to false to render {...} / [[[...]]] text literally without evaluating it.

background_padding.description: Space between the text and the sides of its background box, px.

background_radius.description: Corner radius of the background rect (px).

background_width.description: Fixed explicit width of the background rect (px). Overrides auto-sizing from text metrics. Text will overflow if content is wider than this value.

background_min_width.description: Minimum width of the background rect (px). Auto-sizes to text width but never smaller than this value. Safe for dynamic content.

additionalProperties.description: A text field of the label (the LCARdS text-field keys: content, font, colour, background, position round the point).

content.description: Text of this field. Templates are evaluated (the point's entity is entity; sky and point are available too); template: false shows it as written.

show.description: Whether to show this text field

font_weight.description: Font weight: CSS keyword (normal, bold) or numeric value (100–900)

font_family.description: CSS font-family (single font, comma-separated stack, or CSS variable)

letter_spacing.description: Space between letters: px (a number) or a CSS letter-spacing such as 0.1em or 2px. Default normal.

template.description: Template evaluation is enabled by default for this field’s content (e.g. {entity.state}, {{ states(...) }}, [[[ ... ]]]). Set to false to render {...} / [[[...]]] text literally without evaluating it.

background_padding.description: Space between the text and the sides of its background box, px.

background_radius.description: Corner radius of the background rect (px).

background_width.description: Fixed explicit width of the background rect (px). Overrides auto-sizing from text metrics. Text will overflow if content is wider than this value.

background_min_width.description: Minimum width of the background rect (px). Auto-sizes to text width but never smaller than this value. Safe for dynamic content.

style.description: Label style: a built-in (title 34 px, major 20 px, minor 13 px, tiny 10 px; larger ones win when labels overlap) or one of yours in labels.styles. Default minor.

marker.description: Marker drawn at the point: dot, triangle, diamond, square, reticle (a target ring), ship (a starship from above), starbase (a station: stands in for a model far away), moon_phase (the moon's lit part, from the sky) or none. A point with a marker can be tapped.

color.description: The point's colour: the marker, and the default for its text fields. A colour or a state map by the point's entity (a selected key while it is selected). CSS variables stay live, so alert modes recolour. Default by style: moonlight for title and major, the theme text colour for minor and tiny.

visible.description: false hides the label, marker and card (the point still places other things). Rules use it to hide and show points.

opacity.description: Opacity of the label and marker, 0 to 1.

anyOf.description: A template that gives the number: [[[ return ... ]]], {{ ... }} or {entity.state}.

priority.description: Which label wins when two overlap (higher wins; then the nearer one). Default by style: title 100, major 80, minor 40, tiny 10 (labels.styles can set its own).

anyOf.description: A template that gives the number: [[[ return ... ]]], {{ ... }} or {entity.state}.

leader.description: With a model, globe or cube sitting at the point (its at: names the point), the label stands off the object's edge on screen; true draws a thin line from the edge to the label, false leaves it out.

overlap.description: When labels overlap, this one is never hidden: it still moves to the other side of its point when that is free, else it shows where it is (over the other one). Default: the style's, else labels.overlap (false).

fade.description: Distance fade [start, end], scene units from the camera: fully shown nearer than start, gone past end.

min_distance.description: Hidden when the camera is closer than this, scene units.

anyOf.description: A template that gives the number: [[[ return ... ]]], {{ ... }} or {entity.state}.

max_distance.description: Hidden when the camera is farther than this, scene units (detail that appears as you zoom in).

anyOf.description: A template that gives the number: [[[ return ... ]]], {{ ... }} or {entity.state}.

below_horizon.description: altaz and sky points under the horizon: dim (default for sky), hide, or show (default for altaz).

view.description: Camera keys to land on when this is flown to (by a tap or a fly-to action). Leave out keys to keep the current ones; the distance defaults to a close-up.

distance.description: Camera distance from the point, scene units.

tilt.description: Camera height angle, degrees: 0 level, 90 straight down.

yaw.description: The way the camera faces, degrees (0: facing north).

warp.description: Stars and dust streak while the camera flies here (warp). Default camera.warp.

card.description: A Lovelace card (any card: tile, entities, an LCARdS card) pinned to the point. It follows the point, and hides when the point is off screen, behind an object or out of its distance range.

show.description: tap: a tap on the point opens the card and selects the point (one card open at a time; a tap elsewhere or Escape closes it); the tap_action then runs only when it is fly-to. always: the card is always shown.

position.description: Where the card sits round the point (the label position names). It stays inside the scene.

offset.description: Moves the card by [x, y] px from where position puts it.

width.description: Card width, px; its height follows the card.

card.description: The card config, as on a dashboard (type and its own keys). Its visibility conditions apply.

type.description: The card type, such as tile or custom:lcards-button.

objects.description: What is drawn: grids, volumes, spheres, models, images, glows, nebulae, rings, paths and beams.

id.description: Unique card identifier for rule targeting, animations, and debugging (alphanumeric, underscore, hyphen)

tags.description: Tags for bulk rule targeting and grouping. Allows applying rules to multiple cards at once using tag selectors.

grid_options.description: Home Assistant grid layout options. Controls how many rows and columns this card occupies in the dashboard grid.

oneOf.description: Set to "full" to span all available columns
Number of grid columns this card spans: 12 per section column, so a section with column_span: 4 has 48

columns.description: Number of grid columns (12 per section column; Home Assistant clamps to the section width) or "full" to span all columns

rows.description: Number of rows this card spans (1-100)

oneOf.description: Card height in pixels (bare integer, e.g. 56 = 56px)
Card height with CSS unit (e.g. 200px, 50vh, 10em) or a CSS function: calc(), min(), max(), clamp(), var()

height.description: Card height. Bare integer = px (default 400); CSS units accepted (50vh). The scene fills the card.

oneOf.description: Card width in pixels (bare integer, e.g. 300 = 300px)
Card width with CSS unit (e.g. 400px, 50vw, 10em) or a CSS function: calc(), min(), max(), clamp(), var()

width.description: Card width override. Bare integer = px (e.g. 400 = 400px). CSS units accepted: 400px, 50vw, 10em.

oneOf.description: Minimum card height in pixels (bare integer, e.g. 40 = 40px)
Minimum card height with CSS unit (e.g. 40px, 10vh)

min_height.description: Minimum card height floor. Overrides the --lcards-button-min-height CSS token. Bare integer = px.

oneOf.description: Minimum card width in pixels (bare integer, e.g. 80 = 80px)
Minimum card width with CSS unit (e.g. 80px, 10vw)

min_width.description: Minimum card width floor. Bare integer = px.

oneOf.description: Maximum card height in pixels (bare integer, e.g. 400 = 400px)
Maximum card height with CSS unit (e.g. 400px, 80vh, 20em)

max_height.description: Maximum card height ceiling. Bare integer = px (e.g. 400 = 400px). CSS units accepted: 400px, 80vh, 10em.

oneOf.description: Maximum card width in pixels (bare integer, e.g. 600 = 600px)
Maximum card width with CSS unit (e.g. 600px, 80vw, 20em)

max_width.description: Maximum card width ceiling. Bare integer = px (e.g. 600 = 600px). CSS units accepted: 600px, 80vw, 10em.

z_index.description: CSS z-index stacking order on the card host element.

sounds.description: Per-card sound configuration. Overrides global sound settings for this card.

enabled.description: Whether this card fires sounds. Set to false to completely silence this card. Default: true (omit to keep default).

card_tap.description: Asset key for card tap, or null to mute. Omit to use global scheme.

card_hold.description: Asset key for card hold, or null to mute. Omit to use global scheme.

card_double_tap.description: Asset key for card double-tap, or null to mute. Omit to use global scheme.

card_hover.description: Asset key for card hover (desktop), or null to mute. Omit to use global scheme.

slider_drag_start.description: Asset key for slider grab, or null to mute. Omit to use global scheme.

slider_change.description: Asset key for slider value change, or null to mute. Omit to use global scheme.

slider_drag_end.description: Asset key for slider release, or null to mute. Omit to use global scheme.

toggle_on.description: Asset key for toggle-on, or null to mute. Omit to use global scheme.

toggle_off.description: Asset key for toggle-off, or null to mute. Omit to use global scheme.

state_classification.description: Override how raw entity states are mapped to style buckets. Use built-in buckets (active/inactive/default) or define your own named buckets. Explicit state keys in style config always take priority over this.

active.description: Additional states to classify as "active" (augments the built-in active list).

else.description: Bucket for states not matched by any list (built-in or custom). Accepts built-in bucket names (active/inactive/default) or a custom bucket name. Defaults to "inactive" when omitted.

additionalProperties.description: Custom bucket: an array of raw entity states that map to this bucket name.

items.description: Entity ID whose state change should trigger a re-render

triggers_update.description: Extra entity IDs to watch for state changes. When any listed entity changes, all templates on this card are re-evaluated. Use this for JavaScript templates ([[[...]]]) that reference entities LCARdS cannot detect automatically via static analysis.

data_sources.description: Data sources for real-time entity tracking, historical data, and processing pipelines. Each key defines a named data source accessible in templates.
data_sources.$comment: Data sources enable entity subscriptions, history preload, and unified processing pipeline

attribute.description: Entity attribute to track instead of state

enum_mapping.description: Map non-numeric states to numbers so they can be plotted or processed (on/off map to 1/0 automatically)

periodic_update_interval.description: With a duration processor, ms between the refreshes that keep the elapsed time counting.

hours.description: Hours of history to preload (1-168, default: 6)

processing.description: Processing pipeline with named processors. Each processor transforms data and stores results in a buffer accessible via templates.

additionalProperties.description: A processor in the pipeline. type picks one of: convert_unit, scale, smooth, expression, statistics, rate, trend, duration, threshold, clamp, round, delta.

oneOf.title: convert_unit
oneOf.description: Convert between units (temperature, power, energy, distance, speed, pressure, data).

type.description: convert_unit: Convert between units (temperature, power, energy, distance, speed, pressure, data).

input_source.description: Name of another processor in this pipeline whose output this one reads (creates a dependency chain). If omitted, uses the raw entity value.

enabled.description: Set false to pass values through unchanged (default true)

from.description: Source unit (e.g. c, f, w, kw). Not a chaining key: use input_source.

oneOf.title: scale
oneOf.description: Map a value from one range to another, with an optional curve.

type.description: scale: Map a value from one range to another, with an optional curve.

input_source.description: Name of another processor in this pipeline whose output this one reads (creates a dependency chain). If omitted, uses the raw entity value.

enabled.description: Set false to pass values through unchanged (default true)

oneOf.title: smooth
oneOf.description: Smooth out noise.

input_source.description: Name of another processor in this pipeline whose output this one reads (creates a dependency chain). If omitted, uses the raw entity value.

enabled.description: Set false to pass values through unchanged (default true)

alpha.description: exponential: weight of the newest value, 0 to 1 (default 0.3).

window.description: moving_average and gaussian: samples in the window (default 10).

oneOf.title: expression
oneOf.description: Compute a value with a JavaScript expression.

type.description: expression: Compute a value with a JavaScript expression.

input_source.description: Name of another processor in this pipeline whose output this one reads (creates a dependency chain). If omitted, uses the raw entity value.

enabled.description: Set false to pass values through unchanged (default true)

expression.description: JavaScript expression using value/v, t, sources, entity and Math helpers.

sources.description: Processor names available as sources[0], sources[1], ...

oneOf.title: statistics
oneOf.description: Statistics over a time window.

type.description: statistics: Statistics over a time window.

input_source.description: Name of another processor in this pipeline whose output this one reads (creates a dependency chain). If omitted, uses the raw entity value.

enabled.description: Set false to pass values through unchanged (default true)

stats.description: Which statistics: min, max, mean, median, std_dev, q1, q3, range, count, sum (avg and stddev are aliases).

window.description: Time window: seconds, a duration like "5m", or "session".

max_points.description: Keep a time series of this many results.

oneOf.title: rate
oneOf.description: Rate of change.

input_source.description: Name of another processor in this pipeline whose output this one reads (creates a dependency chain). If omitted, uses the raw entity value.

enabled.description: Set false to pass values through unchanged (default true)

oneOf.title: trend
oneOf.description: Whether the value is rising, falling or stable.

type.description: trend: Whether the value is rising, falling or stable.

input_source.description: Name of another processor in this pipeline whose output this one reads (creates a dependency chain). If omitted, uses the raw entity value.

enabled.description: Set false to pass values through unchanged (default true)

threshold.description: Slope below which the trend is stable.

oneOf.title: duration
oneOf.description: How long a condition has held.

type.description: duration: How long a condition has held.

input_source.description: Name of another processor in this pipeline whose output this one reads (creates a dependency chain). If omitted, uses the raw entity value.

enabled.description: Set false to pass values through unchanged (default true)

condition.description: Condition like "> 20" that starts the timer.

oneOf.title: threshold
oneOf.description: Switch between two outputs at a point.

type.description: threshold: Switch between two outputs at a point.

input_source.description: Name of another processor in this pipeline whose output this one reads (creates a dependency chain). If omitted, uses the raw entity value.

enabled.description: Set false to pass values through unchanged (default true)

hysteresis.description: Dead band around the switch point.

oneOf.title: clamp
oneOf.description: Keep the value within bounds.

type.description: clamp: Keep the value within bounds.

input_source.description: Name of another processor in this pipeline whose output this one reads (creates a dependency chain). If omitted, uses the raw entity value.

enabled.description: Set false to pass values through unchanged (default true)

oneOf.title: round
oneOf.description: Round to a number of decimal places.

type.description: round: Round to a number of decimal places.

input_source.description: Name of another processor in this pipeline whose output this one reads (creates a dependency chain). If omitted, uses the raw entity value.

enabled.description: Set false to pass values through unchanged (default true)

oneOf.title: delta
oneOf.description: Change since the previous value.

type.description: delta: Change since the previous value.

input_source.description: Name of another processor in this pipeline whose output this one reads (creates a dependency chain). If omitted, uses the raw entity value.

enabled.description: Set false to pass values through unchanged (default true)

window_seconds.description: Rolling buffer window: seconds, or a duration like "5m" or "1h". About 10 points per second are kept, at most 1,000 (default 60)

min_emit_ms.description: Minimum ms between updates sent to cards (throttle, default 100)

coalesce_ms.description: Window in ms for merging rapid changes into one update (default: 40% of min_emit_ms; below 20 counts as 20)

max_delay_ms.description: Longest ms an update may be held back while merging (default: 3 x coalesce_ms; never less than min_emit_ms)

emit_on_same_value.description: Send updates even when the value did not change (default true)

variables.description: Your own named values, available to templates as variables.<name> and {variables.<name>}.

view_layout.description: Placement in a custom view layout (e.g. grid-area), read by the view.

visibility.description: Home Assistant visibility conditions: the card shows only while they hold.

layout_options.description: The older name of grid_options, read by Home Assistant.

lcards_astrometrics_card_labels_default_.description: A box behind the text (the LCARS bar-break label): a colour or a state map, as color.

Text colour: a colour or a state map by the point's entity (default, active, inactive, unavailable, a state name, above:N, ...). A selected key colours the field while the point is selected. CSS variables stay live, so alert modes recolour.
Single colour value applied to all entity states
lcards_astrometrics_card_labels_default_.title: Simple Colour
State-Dependent Colours
lcards_astrometrics_card_labels_default_.description: Map of entity state names to colour values. Well-known keys: default, active, inactive, unavailable, zero, non_zero, hover, pressed. Any custom state name (e.g. "heating", "above:90") is also accepted.
Fallback colour when no other state key matches
Colour when entity state is a non-zero number
Colour for a custom state key (e.g. "heating", "cooling", "above:90", "below:20")
Colour when entity state is numeric 0

oneOf.description: Font size in pixels (1-200)
CSS value or theme token

lcards_astrometrics_card_labels_default_.description: Font size: px (a number) or a CSS size (14px, 1.2rem, var(--lcars-text-size)).

oneOf.title: Uniform Padding
oneOf.description: Same padding on all sides (in pixels)

lcards_astrometrics_card_labels_default_.description: Moves the field, px: a number for every side, or { top, right, bottom, left }.

Where this field sits round the point: center (on it), center-right (right of the marker), top-left, bottom-center, ... (right, left, top, bottom are short for the middle ones). Fields with the same position stack. Default center-right with a marker, center without.

lcards_astrometrics_card_points_item_tap.description: Action on a tap or hold: any card action (more-info, toggle, perform-action, navigate, url, ...), or fly-to. fly-to flies the camera to this point or object, or to the named view in view.

pipeline_id.description: assist: the Assist pipeline to open (its id, or preferred)

start_listening.description: assist: start listening for speech when the dialog opens

perform_action.description: Action to perform (format: domain.action); the current Home Assistant name for service

data.description: Data for the action (perform-action), such as brightness for light.turn_on

navigation_path.description: Path to navigate to (must start with /)

url_path.description: url only: the address to open, in a new tab

target.description: What the action acts on: entity_id, device_id, area_id, floor_id or label_id (and exclude), passed to Home Assistant as the action's target

browser_mod.description: fire-dom-event: what browser_mod runs, in its own grammar (service and data, e.g. service: browser_mod.popup), read from the ll-custom event

card.description: fly-to, set-clock and set-model-scale: the id of the astrometrics card to act on (any card on the same dashboard or open in the same browser). On the astrometrics card's own points and objects, leave it out for that card.

view.description: fly-to only: fly to this named view (camera.views) instead of the point or object.

point.description: fly-to only: a point id of that card to fly to (wins over view).

duration.description: fly-to only: how long the flight takes, ms. Default the card's camera.fly_duration.

warp.description: fly-to only: stars and dust streak on the way (warp), or false for none. Default the view's own warp, else the card's camera.warp.

date.description: set-clock only: the scene date, now or an ISO date and time (2026-10-30, 2026-10-30T12:00:00Z). Leave out to keep the date running on.

rate.description: set-clock only: how fast the scene date runs, days per second (1 is a day a second, 0 holds it, negative runs back), or live for real time. Leave out to keep the rate.

model_scale.description: set-model-scale only: real draws the card's models at their real size, visible draws small ones at least 40 px across, toggle (the default) switches between them. Not saved.

lcards_astrometrics_card_points_item_tap.description: Type of action. fly-to: fly the camera here (or to the named view in view, or the point in point; with card, another astrometrics card's camera); the other types run as on any card.
enumDescriptions: Set an astrometrics card's scene date and rate
Change an astrometrics card's model scale

lcards_astrometrics_card_points_item_tex.description: How to format entity state or attribute values in this text field. "friendly" (default) uses Home Assistant's translated display string matching native cards. "raw" returns the unmodified state/attribute value. "parts" joins value and unit from Home Assistant's ToParts API. "unit" returns only the unit portion.

lcards_astrometrics_card_warp_factor.description: Follow an entity: its state (or attribute) mapped from input to output (the map_range keys used across LCARdS), held at the ends. A missing or non-numeric value leaves the default.

attribute.description: Read this attribute instead of the state.

input.description: [low, high] of the entity's value. Default the entity's min and max attributes (an input_number), else 0 to 100.

output.description: [low, high] of the setting the input maps to. Leave out to use the entity's number as it is.

clamp.description: false: a value outside input carries on past the ends of output (default true: held at the ends).

smooth.description: opacity, radius, size and spin ease to a new value over this many ms (default 600; 0 steps). Other keys step.

simpleColorSchema.description: Colour value (hex, rgb, named colour, theme token, or CSS variable)
